user.description: Majestic login for the feeder. Talk-back needs `rtsp.backchannel: true` in the feeder's /etc/majestic.yaml.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address or hostname of the feeder. Leave empty to follow the host entity.
data_description.host_entity: A sensor whose state is a URL naming the feeder, such as catd's Stream URL. Used when Host is empty, so a feeder on DHCP keeps working when its address changes.
data_description.device_id: The `device_id` from /etc/catd.conf; identifies this feeder if you have more than one.

error.no_host: Set a host, or a host entity whose state names the feeder
